description: Mapping from generated PDF page index (1..N, 1-indexed) to the reference_scans/page_*.png that is its semantic ground truth, or null if no suitable reference exists. Re-derived at M2-close under the clip-free pair-keep pagination build (24 physical pages = 21 logical + 3 notes-continuation pairs). See .factory/library/audit-alignment.md and .factory/library/pair-keep-baseline.md for the full derivation + regeneration procedure.

derivation.notes: M2-close pair-keep build renders 24 physical pages. Chapter opener pages (gen 1, 12, 19) are pinned to reference opener pages (105, 114, 119). End-of-chapter pages whose final block is an ornament (gen 11, 18, 24) are pinned to reference ornament pages (113, 118, 122). Notes-continuation pages (gen 14, 17, 23) are body-free apparatus-only pages emitted by Typst's native footnote engine when blocks 31, 35, and 48 respectively carry notes that exceed the per-page apparatus budget — the reference edition has no equivalent, so these map to null. Chapter 1 has 11 gen scoring pages vs 9 ref pages (105-113): refs 106 and 109 are double-booked to absorb the extra 2 gen pages while preserving opener+ornament pins. Chapter 3 has 5 gen scoring pages vs 4 ref (119-122): ref 120 is double-booked. Chapter 2 aligns 5→5 cleanly. This is a many-to-one allowed mapping (audit/image_diff.py permits multiple gen pages to reference the same ref scan). The M1 baseline recorded in validation-state.json before this re-derivation (80.1) was measured against a 15-page build produced under silent Typst footnote-clipping, which is no longer the code path; M2's pair-keep pagination builds clip-free and this alignment map reflects that reality.
